rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE krrg_setting_groups DROP COLUMN sort_order;

changeSet.author: Oleg V. Kryuchin
Oleg V. Kryuchin
changeSet.sql: UPDATE krrg_settings SET sort_order = 1 WHERE code IN ('ai_enable', 'cron_enable', 'folder_enable');

rollback.sql: UPDATE krrg_settings SET sort_order = 3 WHERE code IN ('ai_enable', 'cron_enable', 'folder_enable');

changeSet.author: Oleg V. Kryuchin
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO krrg_setting_groups (code, name, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('hh', 'HH', 6, now(), now());

changeSet.author: Oleg V. Kryuchin
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO krrg_settings (code, title, setting_type, sort_order, group_id, created_at, updated_at) SELECT v.code, v.title, v.setting_type, v.sort_order, g.id, now(), now() FROM (VALUES ('hh_enabled', 'Включено', 'BOOLEAN', 1), ('hh_pause', 'Пауза между откликами (сек)', 'INTEGER', 2), ('hh_letter', 'Сопроводительное письмо', 'STRING', 3), ('hh_log', 'Логируем действия', 'BOOLEAN', 4) ) AS v(code, title, setting_type, sort_order) JOIN krrg_setting_groups g ON g.code = 'hh';

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM krrg_settings WHERE code IN ('hh_enabled', 'hh_pause', 'hh_letter', 'hh_log');
